1.title: Dramatic insider warnings over AI fall flat with some in Silicon Valley
1.summary: A recent spate of stark warnings about the dangers of AI has been met with scepticism by executives and investors.

2.title: As Fears of A.I. Catastrophe Magnify, Washington Stirs, but Mostly Slumbers
2.summary: President Trump has been in the forefront of the “what-me-worry?” crowd, refusing to engage on how to balance the risks and rewards of A.I.

3.title: Angie Nixon, Candidate for Senate, Takes Florida by Storm
3.summary: The Democratic nominee for Senate faces strong headwinds in a decidedly Republican-leaning state. She has been a fighter, and an underdog, for years.

4.title: Tracing the Path of Nepal’s Flood
4.summary: Mujib Mashal, our South Asia bureau chief, travels to points along a river in Nepal that turned into a deadly torrent, killing more than 1,300 people and leaving over 5,000 more missing as entire towns, bridges and roads were swept away.

5.title: Six dead, 107 rescued from Indonesian ferry that went missing in Java Sea
5.summary: Ships and helicopters are searching for the remaining 130 missing people from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.

6.title: How Iran’s Hard-liners Blew Up the Peace Deal with Trump
6.summary: Opponents derailed the agreement with a clandestine effort to attack ships in the Strait of Hormuz, regime insiders say. Iran’s president was furious when he found out.
